description: Per-Slurm-job interconnect evidence from DCGM NVLink and PCIe/ECC counters. No collective-benchmark (bus bandwidth / latency) exporter is live.

options.content:
NCCL runs — NVLink and interconnect health, per Slurm job. Scoped to the GPUs inside the selected job(s). Scope note: bus bandwidth and collective latency have no live producer on this stack, so this board reports the interconnect evidence the trays do emit — NVLink throughput actually observed, and the PCIe / ECC faults that corrupt a collective. Fleet-wide NVLink lane and IMEX state is owned by the NVLink area; fleet-wide GPU faults by GPU Health.

panels.title: Interconnect footprint of the selected run

panels.description: The measurable population for this run — GPUs with an NVLink bandwidth counter over the window. Note a small number of GPUs fleet-wide report a negative counter (a DCGM artefact), so 'moved traffic' + 'silent' can fall a couple short of this total.

targets.expr: count(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_BANDWIDTH_TOTAL[$__range]) and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: GPUs in the selected run(s) with NVLink telemetry

panels.description: Sum over the job's GPUs of each GPU's peak NVLink bandwidth in the selected window. Measured over the window because NVLink reads zero between collectives.

targets.expr: sum(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_BANDWIDTH_TOTAL[$__range]) and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Aggregate peak NVLink throughput of the selected job(s)

panels.description: Highest per-GPU NVLink bandwidth reached anywhere in the run.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_BANDWIDTH_TOTAL[$__range]) and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Busiest single GPU on NVLink in the run

panels.description: Instrumented ranks that never moved a byte over NVLink in the window — they contributed nothing to any collective.

targets.expr: count(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_BANDWIDTH_TOTAL[$__range]) == 0 and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Job GPUs silent on NVLink for the whole window

panels.description: Every GPU inside the selected job(s) that reports an NVLink counter, sorted by peak throughput over the window. Built from the identical selector as both stats above: the footer row count equals the left stat and the first row equals the right stat.

defaults.noValue: No GPU in the selected job reported NVLink throughput in this window.

panels.title: Run GPUs by peak NVLink throughput, busiest first — footer Count = the GPU count on the left; top row = the busiest-GPU stat on the right
Peak NVLink throughput by tray — these rows sum to the aggregate stat above

panels.description: PCIe replays on a rank in this run — a link-integrity problem that silently slows every collective on that rank.

targets.expr: count(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_PCIE_REPLAY_COUNTER[$__range]) > 0 and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Run GPUs that logged a PCIe replay

panels.description: Correctable HBM errors on a rank in this run.

targets.expr: count(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_VOL_TOTAL[$__range]) > 0 and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Run GPUs that logged a single-bit ECC error

panels.description: Uncorrectable HBM errors — this run's results are not trustworthy.

targets.expr: count(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_VOL_TOTAL[$__range]) > 0 and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Run GPUs that logged a double-bit ECC error

panels.description: Driver-level XID on a rank in this run.

targets.expr: count(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS[$__range]) > 0 and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)
